payload.title: notifications settings tab opens
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toBeVisible()

Locator: getByRole('tab', { name: 'Notifications' })
Expected: visible
Received: <element(s) not found>

note: Consistent not-found across both attempts with zero prior history — but settings recently moved from a tab strip to a collapsible accordion, so a role of 'tab' no longer exists on that page at all; there is no timing element to be flaky about. This is distinguished from a true flake by the failure being structural (the element's role was removed) rather than transient.
